headline: Lycia Therapeutics Surges in Market Debut After Upsized $317.5M IPO
summary: Lycia Therapeutics shares surged in their public market debut following an upsized initial public offering that raised $317.5 million.
why: Biotechnology initial public offerings serve as a bellwether for venture capital liquidity and investor risk appetite in life sciences.

impacts.name: Pharmaceuticals
impacts.why: Strong aftermarket performance in biotech IPOs indicates receptive public capital markets for clinical-stage companies.

why_moved: Strong institutional demand for the upsized biotechnology offering sparked immediate secondary market buying upon launch.
